input.summary:
Church nave interior built in parts/room-11.mjs: spruce-stair pews either side of a centre aisle with gap rows, a polished andesite altar with candle and standing lantern at the back, beams at y7 (z11, z14) carrying four chained hanging lanterns, and fence-post lanterns at the narthex corners.
With a scratch floor at y1 (shell-b still a stub), the room check reads OK: 42/42 floor cells reachable, minimum light 10, no dark cells.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with my part, with no off-palette blocks. The only refused write was the lectern at (52,2,16), which the hearths part already placed, so I left it out of my layer.
left: The real nave floor block at y1 (shell-b, a stub here) is not built, so `$MCD room build.nbt --only "church nave"` still reads NEEDS WORK (floor y=3, walk unreachable). Re-run it once shell-b lays the floor; my layout was verified OK on a scratch copy with spruce_planks at y1 (/tmp/nave-test/floor-test.mjs).
The tower ladder (55, 2..7, 16) is locked to the nave, so the altar sits at x53..54 on the back row and the (55,*,16) column is left clear.
Not run in this session: the full `mcd render build.nbt --front n --tiles tiles`, `mcd check` and `mcd fit` on the whole build; only the room-level check and a room.png view were done.

elements.md item 'Lectern, pews (stairs), altar' is ticked, but the lectern is the hearths part's placement, not mine. plan.md's checklist is not ticked: its items are P1..P6, and this is room 11 of the room parts.

waste.what: Worked out the 6x7 nave layout cell by cell in a text grid, then fixed it by hand after make.sh refused the lectern and the tower-ladder column (55,*,16).
waste.tool: A pre-build conflict check in make.sh or build.mjs that lists the locked cells (earlier parts' placements and the ladder column) inside each room box before a part's layers() runs, so a part can plan around them.

toolu_012w7spZMNGnRuttX7CR4sRf.summary:
Church nave interior built in parts/room-11.mjs: spruce-stair pews either side of a centre aisle with gap rows, a polished andesite altar with candle and standing lantern at the back, beams at y7 (z11, z14) carrying four chained hanging lanterns, and fence-post lanterns at the narthex corners.
With a scratch floor at y1 (shell-b still a stub), the room check reads OK: 42/42 floor cells reachable, minimum light 10, no dark cells.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with my part, with no off-palette blocks. The only refused write was the lectern at (52,2,16), which the hearths part already placed, so I left it out of my layer.
left: The real nave floor block at y1 (shell-b, a stub here) is not built, so `$MCD room build.nbt --only "church nave"` still reads NEEDS WORK (floor y=3, walk unreachable). Re-run it once shell-b lays the floor; my layout was verified OK on a scratch copy with spruce_planks at y1 (/tmp/nave-test/floor-test.mjs).
The tower ladder (55, 2..7, 16) is locked to the nave, so the altar sits at x53..54 on the back row and the (55,*,16) column is left clear.
Not run in this session: the full `mcd render build.nbt --front n --tiles tiles`, `mcd check` and `mcd fit` on the whole build; only the room-level check and a room.png view were done.
